Class GatedDeltaNet

java.lang.Object
smile.llm.model.qwen.GatedDeltaNet
public class GatedDeltaNet extends Object

    • replaceGemmProjections

      public void replaceGemmProjections(LinearOp qkv, LinearOp z, LinearOp out)
      Replaces GEMM projections typically present as FP8 in Qwen checkpoints (in_proj_qkv, in_proj_z, out_proj), leaving dense in_proj_a/in_proj_b for the residual load path.
      Parameters:
      qkv - combined QKV projection op.
      z - z-gate projection op.
      out - output projection op.
